text_block_list.text:
Looking far ahead from the Junior Class to 
the grand stage of the BC, Espoir City 
demonstrates a run overflowing with 
fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa—... Alright! Did'ja see that, 
punk! Nailed it with room to spare today, 
too...!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Alright, let's call it a day here.
Yeah! All right, let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
âWait, isn't that girl from "DREAMS"...? 
âHey, hey, is she really taking on the 
BC? âTaking on the world? My legs would 
give out~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
…………Tch. Quit your damn chirping, it's 
annoying.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Coming right out.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—...Huh? Mom? ...What? "I'm in the 
neighborhood"?!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry to interrupt out of nowhere. 
I was just a little concerned about how 
you were doing...
choice_data_list: No, no, it's a good opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I was surprised! To think you'd 
aim for the BC... You've truly grown 
admirable.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmph... This much is totally normal.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? But on a grand stage like 
the BC, Mom would probably freeze right in 
her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Are you doing okay, Espo? You haven't been 
losing sleep or anything, have you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's this all of a sudden...? I've 
been sleeping just fine, thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Really? But even if you act like you're 
fine... I can't help but worry you might 
actually be pushing yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, this is totally a breeze, okay? 
Like, what do you even mean by 
'impossible' or whatever...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, don't sweat it. I'm busting my 
butt working toward the BC.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. I went and asked 
something unnecessary, didn't I? I'm 
sorry, Espo."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, please look after my 
daughter. Please support Espo, okay?”

Espoir City watched her mother until she 
was out of sight. Once she was gone, she 
muttered softly under her breath...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, I told you you don't need to 
worry about me...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...No matter what... I'm definitely... 
winning at the BC...!

"I want to become the best in the world 
and show how strong I am." The bigger that 
desire, the more anxiety and fear of 
failure swell up.

What could I do to support her? After 
thinking it over for a while—
choice_data_list:
Could you drop by the Trainer's office for 
a bit?

Could you drop by the Trainer's office for 
a bit?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What, what a pain in the neck.

Upon returning to the trainer's office, I 
took out a notebook that had been stored 
in my desk drawer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that your "textbook"? What're you 
pullin' that out for?

"These are the notebooks where I wrote 
down my observations and notes for 
coaching Espoir City. However..."
choice_data_list: From now on, this is "our" textbook.
From now on, this is "our" textbook, okay?

text_block_list.text:
When I first used the 'Textbook', putting 
it into words showed me what I needed to 
do. That's why—
choice_data_list:
Let's leave the promise you made to your 
mother earlier right here.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That promise from earlier about 'me 
beating the BC' is...
choice_data_list:
If we give form to our promise, we won't 
lose our way.

text_block_list.text:
After a moment of silence, Espoir City 
quietly picked up the "textbook." And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ......Here ya go.

Two things were written in the notebook in 
large letters. One of them was—
choice_data_list: ..."I'm definitely gonna win the BC!" And—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—"I'll prove there's nothin' to worry 
about!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I am the strongest horse girl. I'll prove 
it to Mom... and to the whole world."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"You better brace yourself too, got it? 
Everything written here is definitely 
coming true!"

Clutching the notebook, I nod to her. And 
so, together with Espoir City, we renewed 
our vow to win the BC.
